Question ID: BIO_U06_L04_GP_Q04

MLA Standard: MLA.BIO.ECO.02

Assessment focus: Use the embedded Unit 6 ecology stimulus exactly as written.

Food web change: A disease reduces rabbit populations. Coyotes eat rabbits as a major food source. Grasses are eaten by rabbits.

Which prediction is most reasonable?

answer.text: Coyotes must increase because rabbits decrease.

feedback.text: This choice does not use the included stimulus. Recheck the embedded map, graph, table, food web, model, or scenario and connect the answer to the lesson standard.

answer.text: Grasses must decrease because fewer rabbits eat them.

feedback.text: This choice confuses ecological evidence, mechanism, relationship, or decision reasoning. Recheck the embedded map, graph, table, food web, model, or scenario and connect the answer to the lesson standard.

answer.text: Coyotes may decrease and grasses may increase.

feedback.text: Fewer rabbits can reduce food for coyotes and reduce grazing pressure on grasses. This matches the mapped Unit 6 lesson content and uses the included stimulus.
